# ai-cost-ops Rules

Rules for AI infrastructure cost management — model routing, token budgets, prompt caching, batch processing, vendor abstraction, and credit lifecycle tracking. Distinct from cloud FinOps (finops domain) which covers traditional infrastructure costs.

## Applies To

docs/cost-ops/**
docs/planning/cost-governance/**
config/models/**
config/pricing/**
**/\*.prompt
**/\*.prompt.md

## Advisory Rules

- **[aicost-model-routing]** Select AI models based on quality-cost tradeoffs per use case. Use smaller, cheaper models (Haiku, GPT-4o-mini) for simple tasks like formatting, classification, and extraction. Reserve large models (Opus, GPT-4o) for complex reasoning, code generation, and multi-step planning. Document model selection rationale in config/models/ and review quarterly.

- **[aicost-token-budget]** Establish estimated token budgets per command or agent operation. Track input and output token counts. Flag operations that consistently exceed 2x their estimated budget. Budget overruns should trigger a prompt efficiency review, not a budget increase.

- **[aicost-cache-first]** Use provider prompt caching (Anthropic prompt caching, OpenAI cached context) for stable system prompts and frequently repeated instructions. Target a cache hit rate above 60% for system-level prompts. Measure and report cache hit rates in cost monitoring.

- **[aicost-batch-eligible]** Use batch APIs (Anthropic Message Batches, OpenAI Batch API) for non-latency-sensitive operations such as bulk analysis, report generation, and offline processing. Batch APIs typically offer 50% cost reduction. Tag eligible operations in command metadata.

- **[aicost-vendor-lock]** Maintain an abstraction layer for AI provider switching. Do not hardcode provider-specific API calls in business logic. Use a model routing configuration that maps task types to providers, enabling seamless failover and cost arbitrage between vendors.

- **[aicost-credit-tracking]** Track all AI vendor credits, grants, and promotional allocations with expiration dates. Maintain a credit ledger in config/pricing/ with provider, amount, expiry, and utilization percentage. Alert when credits reach 80% utilization or 30 days before expiry.
